Definition: from the participle of G548; a being away:--absence.
BiblicalUsage: Paul tells the Philippians to work out their salvation with fear and trembling, not only in his presence but much more in his absence. The word is simply being away, and Paul counts on their obedience holding when no one is watching.
TheologicalSignificance: Faithfulness that only works under watch is not faithfulness at all.
